senses.gloss: to join, arrive (cmp. אָתָא), to come forth, appear.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:4">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>כל א׳ וא׳ ה׳ בזמנו</he> each (part of creation) came forth in its due time (though all were created at once).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:2">Deut. XXXIII, 2</cite>) <he>מפארן ה׳ ממונם וכ׳</he> from (what occurred at) Paran (the gentiles refusing to receive the Law) he (the Lord) transferred their wealth to Israel.

senses.gloss: to bring about, bring to light, reveal.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90">Gen. R. s. 90</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:2">Yalk. ib. 148</cite> (play on <he>צ̇פ̇נ̇ת̇ פ̇ע̇נ̇ח̇</he>) <he>צפ̇ונ̇ות̇ הופ̇יע̇ ונ̇ח̇ות וכ׳</he> he reveals secrets, and it is easy to him to tell them; <he>צ̇פ̇ונ̇ות̇ הופיע̇ בדעת מנ̇יח̇ וכ׳</he> he brings secret things to light through his intelligence; with them he sets mankind at ease.

<cite ref="Makkot 23b">Macc. 23ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>בג׳ מקומות ה׳ רוה״ק</he> on three occasions did the holy spirit reveal (the true state of affairs); (oth. opin. v. <cite ref="Q00296"><he>פּוּעַ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:3">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> (play on <cite ref="Q00298"><he>פועה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 1:15">Ex. I, 15</cite>) <he>שהוֹפִיעָה את מעשה אחיה</he> she (Miriam) brought about what happened to her brother (she was the cause of Moses’ peculiar career).
Ex. R. s. 1 (play on פועה, v. supra) שהופיעה את ישראל וכ׳ she (Miriam) lifted Israel up to God.—ה׳ פנים כנגד to lift one’s face up against, to have the courage to rebuke.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite> <he>שהופיעה פ׳ … וזקפה וכ׳</he> she lifted her face up against Pharaoh and turned her nose up against him (in angry rebuke).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite> <he>שה׳ פ׳ כנגד אביה</he> she dared to reprove her father. Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ top.
